Title: Authenticate and log out
Description: The system shall authenticate users with a username and password and allow secure logout.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-01; I: Table 13 (individual login, 14/14); Q: D23 username and password 11/15
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Valid credentials create a session; invalid credentials give one generic message; logout destroys the session server-side and is audit-logged.

Title: Change and reset password
Description: The system shall allow users to change their password and allow the administrator to reset passwords, storing passwords only as salted hashes.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-02; Q: D23 admin password reset 11/15
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Passwords stored with password_hash; admin reset forces change at next login; old password required to change own password; no password appears in logs.

Title: Role-based function restriction
Description: The system shall restrict functions according to the user's role (Administrator, Director, Project Manager, Quantity Surveyor, Site Engineer, Client), enforced on every API request.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-03, Table 3.9; I: Table 10; Q: D19, D23 role-limited access 13/15
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Each endpoint has a declared permission; deny by default; a forbidden call returns 403 and is audit-logged; tests cover every role against the permission matrix.

Title: Assigned-project restriction
Description: The system shall restrict each user to the projects assigned to that user, except the Director (read access to all projects) and the Administrator (no project editing duties).
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-04 (amended per MP s4.6); I: Table 10 Director 'all projects'
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Every request carrying a project, activity or record ID is checked against assignments; an unassigned ID returns 403 (IDOR blocked) and is audit-logged.

Title: User administration
Description: The system shall allow the administrator to create, deactivate and edit user accounts and roles, with secure first-administrator provisioning and no public self-registration.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-05; I: Table 10 Administrator
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Admin can create, edit, activate, deactivate; deactivated users lose active sessions; first admin created by a one-time setup command; role changes audit-logged.

Title: Project management
Description: The system shall allow the project manager to create and update projects (code, name, type, location, client, contract sum, planned and actual dates, contractual payment period, status: planning, active, on hold, completed, archived).
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-06; DR: Table 6 project name, location, contract sum
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: PM who creates a project is auto-assigned; planned finish not before planned start; contract sum DECIMAL >= 0; archive instead of delete; any project type supported.

Title: Assign users to projects
Description: The system shall allow the administrator or project manager to assign users to projects.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-07; I: Table 10 PM user assignment
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Unique (project, user) pair enforced by constraint; assignment changes audit-logged; removal takes effect on the next request.

Title: Activities
Description: The system shall allow activities to be created and updated with planned start and finish dates, actual dates, budgeted cost and optional dependencies. The PM and site engineers create and edit activities on assigned projects (decision 21/10/2026); only the PM sets budgeted cost, because site engineers never see cost data.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-08; DR: Table 6 activities (15 docs), budgeted cost per activity (9); Q: B3
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Roles: PM, SE (assigned; SE without cost fields)
Acceptance criteria: Date order validated; budgeted cost DECIMAL >= 0 or empty (then duration weighting applies); archive instead of delete.

Title: Record progress
Description: The system shall allow site engineers and project managers to record dated progress (percentage complete, 0 to 100) with remarks for an activity.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-09; Q: B1 (3.33); I: Theme 1 manual relay
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: One-screen entry per activity; date pre-filled to today (Africa/Accra); 0 to 100 enforced; entry saved as Submitted.

Title: Project completion %
Description: The system shall calculate project completion percentage using budgeted-cost weighting (EV / BAC x 100), falling back to duration weighting, clearly labelled, when activity costs are absent.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: s2.2.7, Table 3.10; I: PM-01 weighted completion; DR: F1 completion % (16 docs); Q: D18 13/15
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Matches the Table 2.1 worked example (35%); uses approved progress only; BAC = 0 shows 'not available'.

Title: Planned versus earned value
Description: The system shall calculate and display planned value against earned value over time (planned versus actual progress).
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-11; I: Table 6 (14/14); Q: B2 (3.13), C3; DR: E7 Weak 64%
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Roles: Director, PM, QS, SE (progress only, no cost values)
Acceptance criteria: PV uses the linear planned % rule; chart plots cumulative PV and EV by reporting period; matches hand-calculated example (PV 98,000; EV 70,000).

Title: Schedule status and delayed activities
Description: The system shall determine each activity's schedule status (not started, late start, in progress, delayed, completed, completed late) from its dates and progress and list delayed activities.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-12; Q: C4, B12 (2.47 lowest); DR: E8 Weak 36/36; I: Table 6 delayed list 7/14
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Status shown with colour, text and icon; each of the six states covered by a unit test; delayed list sortable by days late.

Title: Milestones
Description: The system shall allow milestones to be defined and marked as achieved, and display upcoming, achieved and overdue milestones.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-13; Q: B4, C5; I: Table 6 (8/14), clients' milestone timeline
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Roles: PM (edit); all others view per matrix
Acceptance criteria: Due and achieved dates stored; optional link to an activity; overdue state computed; client timeline shows milestones only.

Title: Approved budget and revisions
Description: The system shall allow the quantity surveyor to record the approved project budget and its revisions (draft, pending approval, approved, rejected, superseded), never overwriting the baseline.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-14; DR: Table 6 budget (2 sources); I: C5 budget revisions acted on before QS told
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Exactly one current approved version per project (constraint plus transaction); history retained; amounts DECIMAL(15,2).

Title: Expenditure
Description: The system shall allow the quantity surveyor to record expenditure entries against a project and, optionally, an activity.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-15; Q: B5; DR: expenditure single source (DT-10)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Amount > 0, date not in the future, category from list; single-source field validation (confirmation step); hidden from SE and Client in API responses.

Title: Budget versus expenditure, CV, CPI
Description: The system shall display budget against expenditure, budget consumed, budget variance, cost variance and cost performance index.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-16; Q: C6, B6; I: C4 manual CPI errors; DR: F1 CV/CPI in 19 docs, E9 Weak 67%
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: CV = EV - AC; CPI not shown when AC = 0; budget consumed = AC / current approved budget; total budget never used as EV or AC.

Title: SV and SPI
Description: The system shall calculate and display schedule variance and schedule performance index.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-17; DR: F1 SV/SPI in 12 docs; I: role needs (Director, PM)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Override: No questionnaire item; thesis priority kept
Acceptance criteria: SV = EV - PV; SPI not shown when PV = 0; matches worked example (SV -28,000; SPI 0.71).

Title: Labour and materials
Description: The system shall allow labour and material records (attendance, quantities received and used, balance) to be entered and summarised per project.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-18; Q: B7, B8, C7; I: Table 5 material stock hardest to obtain (6)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Roles: SE, PM (assigned); QS view; Director view
Acceptance criteria: Standard units from a list; balance = received - used; labour details hidden from Client; rates hidden from SE.

Title: Equipment status
Description: The system shall allow equipment records (equipment on site and status) to be entered per project, with an in-app alert when equipment is reported faulty (A14).
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-19; E10 equipment part follows D11 (master prompt s4.10); I: Table 8 equipment fault (3)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Status list (working, faulty, idle, off site); faulty raises A14 once; no fleet management.

Title: In-app alerts
Description: The system shall generate in-app alerts for delayed activities, late starts, upcoming and overdue milestones, budget thresholds, poor cost or schedule performance, overdue certificates, stale data, pending approvals and work stoppage or safety incidents (rules A1 to A15), with severity, read, acknowledge and resolve states and de-duplication.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-20, Table 3.11; I: Table 8; DR: F3 alerts top need (16 docs), E8 Weak 100%
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Override: O3 (D12, D13, E15); O3 (E14 to Should)
Acceptance criteria: An alert is created when its condition first becomes true and not again until cleared; evaluated on save and on the first dashboard request each day; recipients follow the table; clients receive A4 notice only.
Test IDs: FT-22, FT-23, FT-24; UT-ALERT-01 to UT-ALERT-16

Title: Two-level alert thresholds
Description: The system shall let the Director set global threshold limits, the PM set project thresholds within those limits, and the QS propose cost thresholds for Director approval; the Administrator maintains system settings.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-21 (amended); I: s5.1 threshold ownership (9 internal)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested)
Acceptance criteria: A project threshold outside the global limit is rejected; QS proposals need Director approval; every change audit-logged.

Title: SMS for critical and high alerts
Description: The system shall send SMS notifications to the responsible users for Critical and High alerts (A1 > 14 days, A4, A6b > 10% overrun, A9, A12, A15), with a per-user daily cap and an optional monthly cap, through a gateway adapter (log-only sandbox and HTTP adapter).
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-22; I: Table 9, DIR-01 rule; QS-01 monthly cap; PM-02 overload
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: One SMS per alert; capped messages logged as 'capped'; credentials only from environment; sandbox adapter used in tests; no claim of delivery until a real provider is tested.

Title: Consolidated overview
Description: The system shall present indicators through KPI cards (with formula tooltips), charts, progress bars and tables on a consolidated project overview.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-23; Q: D18, D20; I: Table 11; Q: C11 top challenge (3.67)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Roles: Director, PM, QS, SE (no cost), Administrator (summary)
Acceptance criteria: Overview shows KPI cards, PV/EV line chart, budget vs expenditure bar chart, delayed table, milestones, open alerts, last updated; status uses colour plus text and icon.

Title: Refresh and last-updated stamp
Description: The system shall refresh dashboard data automatically at a configurable interval (60 s default) and display the date and time of the latest update on every dashboard and KPI view.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-24, s1.11; I: Table 6 last updated 14/14; Q: E22 8/15 'immediately'
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Light 'changed-since' endpoint; full data only when changed; pauses when tab hidden; last successful refresh shown separately; backoff on failure; 'waking server' state.

Title: Audit trail
Description: The system shall record an append-only audit trail of logins, failed logins, logouts, record creation, updates, deletions and archives, role and assignment changes, threshold changes, approvals and rejections, exports, backups and restores, and 403 attempts.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-25; Q: D23 activity log 11/15; I: Table 13 (8)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested)
Acceptance criteria: Actor, action, entity, ID, old and new values, IP, user agent, timestamp; no update or delete path; DB user lacks UPDATE/DELETE on audit_logs; no secrets stored.

Title: Export reports (corrected wording)
Description: The system shall export reports in PDF and CSV formats (project status, delayed activities, milestone status, expenditure listing, budget status, cost-variance summary, valuations and payments, resources, alerts, audit for the Administrator, and a one-page client progress and payment summary), limited to the data the user may view.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-26 (garbled, corrected); I: s5.3 reports list
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Roles: Admin, Director, PM, QS; Client (own summary)
Acceptance criteria: Same queries and permissions as dashboards; CSV cells starting with = + - @ are neutralised; exports streamed, not stored; export audit-logged.

Title: Client read-only summary
Description: The system shall provide clients with a read-only summary of progress, schedule, milestones, budget status and payment status (contract sum, certified, paid) for their own projects only.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.4 FR-27; I: s4.2 clients (5/5); Q: D22 hidden fields
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: API response contains no expenditure lines, labour details, budget revisions, internal alerts, supplier prices or other clients' data (verified by field-level test).

Title: Valuations and payment certificates
Description: The system shall record payment certificates (valuation amount, amount certified, certification date) and payment transactions (partial and multiple), and show outstanding balance and status (submitted, certified, part-paid, paid, overdue).
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.8 FR-23 (missing from Table 3.4), Table 3.11 A9; I: Table 4 QS incidents; DR: DT-09
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Roles: QS (assigned); PM, Director view; Client totals only
Acceptance criteria: Certification and payment kept separate; outstanding = certified - sum(paid); unique certificate number per project; overdue after submission + payment period.

Title: Unified login and role-based redirect
Description: The system shall provide one login page for all users and redirect each user, from trusted server records, to the dashboard of their role; another role's URL returns 403 and is audit-logged.
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: No role field in the form, URL or cookie; logged-in user opening /login goes to own dashboard; session ID regenerated; lockout after repeated failures; idle timeout; CSRF token.

Title: PM approval of progress
Description: The system shall require the project manager to approve or return (with reason) progress entries; only approved entries count towards KPIs; the submitter sees confirmation and current status.
Source (document, section/table/item): I: s5.2 (DIR-01, PM-01, PM-02), Table 14 confirmation (SE-01, SE-04); DR: feedback missing 56%
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: States submitted, approved, returned; resubmission allowed; A13 raised for pending entries; approval audit-logged with approver and time.

Title: Director approval of budget revisions
Description: The system shall require the Director to approve or reject budget revisions requested by the PM or QS before they become current.
Source (document, section/table/item): I: s5.2 (QS-01, QS-02, DIR-01); I: Table 9 unapproved revision SMS
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Approval supersedes the previous current version in one transaction; A12 raised while pending; separation of duties: requester cannot approve.

Title: Delay-reason dropdown
Description: The system shall offer a delay-reason list with each progress entry, including 'Work stoppage' and 'Safety incident', which raise a Critical alert (A15).
Source (document, section/table/item): I: Table 14 (SE-03, SE-04); I: Table 9 stoppage/safety (DIR-01, PM-02, SE-02, SE-04)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Override: O2 (A15 in FR-20 depends on it); interview-derived
Acceptance criteria: Reasons from a maintained lookup table; stoppage or safety selection raises A15 once per record; not a safety module.

Title: Material requests and store balance
Description: The system shall provide a simple material request tracker (requested, approved, delivered, cancelled) and show store balances with reorder levels.
Source (document, section/table/item): I: Table 14 (PM-01, PM-02, SE-01 to SE-04); I: Table 5
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Request status visible to requester; balance never negative without warning; supplier prices hidden from SE and Client.

Title: Material reorder alert
Description: The system shall raise an in-app alert (A10) when a material balance falls below its reorder level.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.7 Could Have; I: Table 8 material low (4)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Raised once when balance first drops below reorder level; cleared when restocked.

Title: Director cross-project view
Description: The system shall give the Director a consolidated cross-project comparison (% complete, CV, SV, delayed activities, upcoming milestones, open alerts) for all projects without assignment.
Source (document, section/table/item): I: s4.2 Director; MP: s4.6
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Database tables: projects, activities, progress_records, budgets, expenditures, notifications
Acceptance criteria: Shows every non-archived project; read-only; same KPI service as project view.

Title: Backup and restore function
Description: The system shall provide a daily full logical backup through an administrator function and a token-protected endpoint for an external scheduler, compressed and encrypted, delivered off the host, with 7 daily and 4 weekly retention and a documented, tested restore.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: s3.17.5, NFR-06; I: Table 13 daily backups 14/14; Q: D23 daily backup 7/15
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested)
Acceptance criteria: Backup file decrypts and restores into a separate database with matching record counts and KPI values (FT-32); backup and restore audit-logged.

Title: Form resilience and draft autosave
Description: The system shall keep form input on failure, state clearly that data were not saved, and autosave unsaved drafts in the browser.
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Failed submit keeps values and shows 'not saved'; draft restored after reload; draft cleared after successful save.

Title: Offline operation with synchronisation
Description: The system shall work offline as an installable web app: cached app shell and last-synced read-only views, offline capture of progress, labour, material and equipment entries (progress in Iteration 1; the others as their modules arrive) in an encrypted local queue, and automatic synchronisation with server-side validation when the connection returns.
Source (document, section/table/item): MP: s8.17 and s0 mission; Q: F2 (4.40, 12/15); I: SE-01, SE-04, SE-02; DR: s11 item 8
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Roles: SE first; then PM, QS read views
Acceptance criteria: Each queued entry has a client UUID (idempotent replay); server re-checks role, assignment and validation; conflicts shown to the user; offline views marked 'offline, last synced at'; logout clears local data.

Title: Progress photo
Description: The system shall allow one optional photo per progress entry, compressed in the browser to about 200 KB, type-checked and stored in the database or external object storage.
Source (document, section/table/item): DR: s11 item 8, DT-03 WhatsApp photos hard to search; MP s4.13
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Only JPEG/PNG/WebP accepted after server-side check; never stored on web server disk; hidden from Client unless approved (default hidden).

Title: Days remaining to planned completion
Description: The system shall show the number of days remaining to the planned completion date on the project KPI cards.
Source (document, section/table/item): Q: D21 'Time remaining to projected contract end date'
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Shows planned finish minus today in days; negative shown as 'x days past planned completion'; no forecast.

Title: Dark and light theme
Description: The system shall offer a dark/light mode toggle that remembers the user's choice.
Source (document, section/table/item): MP: s0 mission (owner directive)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Toggle on every page; both themes meet WCAG AA contrast for text and status badges.

Title: Security
Description: Use HTTPS; hash passwords; use prepared statements; encode output; protect state-changing requests with CSRF tokens; manage sessions securely (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, regeneration, idle timeout); throttle failed logins; security headers; least-privilege DB account; secrets outside web root and Git. OWASP Top 10 and ASVS Level 1.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.5 NFR-01; Q: D17 data security 10/15, D23; I: Table 13
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: ST-01 to ST-16 pass; no stack traces in production; headers verified.

Title: Performance (completed)
Description: API summary calls respond within 2 s at the 95th percentile and full pages load within 3 s on a throttled mobile network with 20 concurrent users.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.5 NFR-02 (incomplete '2s'); MP s4.9 targets
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: PT-01, PT-02 and PT-05 meet targets; results reported honestly with tool and settings.

Title: Low bandwidth
Description: Minimise data transferred: cache static assets, compress responses, return summary data on refresh, pause refresh when the tab is hidden, avoid large images.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.5 NFR-03; Q: D17 data cost 7/15, connectivity 11/15; I: low data use (4)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Unchanged poll response under 1 KB; gzip on; static assets cached.

Title: Responsive, mobile-first
Description: Display and function correctly on smartphones from 360 px width, tablets and desktops, with large touch targets.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.5 NFR-04; Q: D16 smartphone 9/15; I: mobile layout (12)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: No horizontal scroll at 360 px; touch targets >= 44 px; main tasks completed on a phone.

Title: Usability
Description: Use plain construction labels, consistent layout and short forms with dropdowns and defaults; require no more than basic computer skills; WCAG 2.1 AA where practicable.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.5 NFR-05; I: simplicity (11), Director quote; Q: D17 training 9/15
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Evaluation tasks T1 to T11 completable; SUS collected (indicative); status never by colour alone.

Title: Backup and recovery (completed)
Description: Back up the database daily, keep an off-site copy, and restore within RTO 4 hours with at most 24 hours of data loss (RPO).
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.5 NFR-06 (RTO missing); I: Table 13 recovery within hours, 1 day loss (DIR-01, QS-01, QS-02)

Title: Data integrity
Description: Validate inputs (types, ranges, date order, 0 to 100 %, non-negative amounts); enforce foreign keys, unique pairs, one current budget; use transactions; archive instead of delete; standard units and formats; extra validation for single-source fields.

Acceptance criteria: Invalid input rejected with field messages by server; constraint tests pass.

Title: Data-entry efficiency

Title: Availability
Description: Host the application off-site so site power interruptions affect only users' devices; report clearly when a request fails; handle cold starts.
Source (document, section/table/item): T: Table 3.5 NFR-09; Q: D17 power 4/15; I: off-site hosting (4)
Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested); Obj 5 / RQ5 (evaluated)
Acceptance criteria: Failure message on every failed request; 'waking up the server' state; /health endpoint.

Title: Configurability

Objective / RQ: Obj 2 / RQ2 (derived); Obj 3 / RQ3 (built); Obj 4 / RQ4 (tested)
